description: Initial raw dataset loaded from UCI Online Retail repository
Drop rows missing InvoiceNo or StockCode. Keep missing CustomerID
Drop non-product entries (POST, DOT, BANK CHARGES, fees, manual adjustments, invalid code patterns)
Drop identical duplicate rows across all fields
Standardize product descriptions and map each distinct StockCode to its most frequent description
Restrict analysis scope to UK invoices only (as pre-registered in CA1)
Group completed UK transactions by InvoiceNo into sets of distinct StockCodes
Drop single-item baskets for association rule mining (a 1-item basket cannot contain co-purchases)
One-hot encode baskets into boolean matrix; pre-filter items below support floor 0.5% (83 baskets) to optimize memory
